life_event: Born in Atlanta, Georgia 1958 Family moved to Hialeah, Florida He shot his stepfather, Nilo DeBag, who did not press charges, but Hilton’s mother
would not allow him back into the house until right before he started school
Enrolled in Miami Springs Junior High
Dawn and Mark Jeffers took in Hilton when his mother wouldn’t 1964-67 Served in the Army. Spent some time in Germany where he got his GED
Honorably discharged from the army

He brought home his new wife, Ursula, from Germany 1969 Married to 1st wife Sue at DeKalb County, Georgia 1970-1972 Qualified for a Florida chauffeurs’ license 1971 Divorced Sue in Miami, Florida 1972 Arrest warrant was dismissed
Was convicted of a DUI in Dade County, Florida
Married Dina Evonne Baugh in DeKalb County, Georgia
Divorced Dina Baugh
Married Betty Sue Galloway
Divorced Galloway
Arrested for arson Convicted in Clayton County, Georgia for possession of drugs and carrying a weapon
without a license
Charged in DeKalb County with theft by deception and possession of marijuana
Plead guilty to theft by deception and possession of marijuana
Charged in Cobb County with 21 counts of solicitation
Theft by Taking
Plead guilty of 21 counts of solicitation. Sentenced to 10 years of probation
Arrested in DeKalb County for stealing books from American Book Display Company
Plead guilty to theft and received five years of probation
Produced the movie Deadly Run Met John Tabor, who gave him a place to live and employment. For the next ten years
sold siding for Insulated Wall Systems.
Rossana Miliani turns up missing while hiking in Bryson City, North Carolina John Tabor filed a complaint; Hilton threatened to kill him if not paid $10,000.
(Duluth Gwinnet County, Georgia)
Hilton murders Irene Bryant and abducts John Bryant
Body of Irene Bryant is discovered
Michael Scot Louis reported missing
Cheryl Dunlap abducted Michael Scot Louis’ body found in 3 different garbage bags at Tomoka State Park in
Florida Dunlap’s body was found by Greg and Wyatt in Apalachicola National Forest in
Florida
Hilton abducted Meredith Emerson
Hilton murdered Emerson Hilton arrested in the disappearance of Emerson after ID and blood-stained clothes are
found in a convenience store trash bin
Emerson’s body is found Law enforcement officials from Georgia, North Carolina and Florida met to compare
notes on Hilton
Hilton indicted for the murder of Meredith Emerson
John Bryant’s body found in Nantahala National Forest, N.C.
Indicted in Florida
Hilton confesses to killing Emerson
Hilton extradited to Florida for Dunlap murder
Pretrial proceeding
Trial date set
Trial begins in Georgia for the murder of Meredith Emerson. Closing arguments, Verdict-Hilton was found guilty of 1st degree murder, kidnapping
and theft. Hilton receives a life sentence. Convicted in Florida for the murder, kidnapping, and robbing of Cheryl Dunlap. Jury
recommends the death penalty.
Judge agreed with jury recommendation and sentenced Hilton to death.
Hilton placed into death row at the Florida State Prison
Feds decide to charge Hilton with Irene and John Bryant’s murder Hilton pleads not guilty in the U.S. District Court in North Carolina for the deaths of
Irene and John Bryant.
